newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life gains as Merrill repeats "add".
newsitem.headline: Sun Life gains as Merrill repeats "add".

text.p: Shares in Sun Life & Provincial were higher on Monday after analysts at Merrill Lynch repeated an "accumulate" rating on the shares, dealers said.
The shares had gained 14-1/2p to 317-1/2p by 1026 GMT after earlier reaching a twelve month high of 319p.
"Sun Life has basically been left behind the rest of the life sector, which is up very strongly," said Merrill Lynch analyst Roman Cizdyn.
Since the beginning of the year the shares have underperformed the sector by ten percent, according to data from Securities 3000.
